s2.title: Your Nightly Wine Is Killing Your Abs
s2.hook: The nightly glass of wine is the one people defend the hardest.
s2.body:
Two glasses a night is 14 glasses a week. That's around 1,700 calories, plus seven nights of degraded sleep every week, forever. There is no version of that where you get abs.

And be honest about what the occasion actually is. If you're counting the Wednesday beers as not really drinking because it was only two, you're only counting the times you noticed.

A lot of guys fail to lose their belly fat because they count what they're eating, but not the calories in their beers, their cocktails and their liquor. Those calories count whether you write them down or not.

s1.title: Your Drinks Should Taste Bad
s1.hook: When you drink alcohol, it should taste bad.
s1.body:
If it tastes bad, it's not sugary. And it has a second benefit that's even more important: you drink less.

When alcohol tastes good, you keep drinking it even when you don't want to get any drunker. Most guys don't have six margaritas because they want to be six drinks drunk. They had six because they tasted like dessert.

So kill the sugary mixers. Cocktails and sugary mixed drinks are a double hit: alcohol and liquid sugar at the same time. You want dry wine, or spirits with soda water and lime.

s4.title: What Killed My Urge To Drink
s4.hook: I used to drink 5 to 10 drinks a week, and most weeks it was closer to 10.
s4.body:
One or two on a date, then a blowout party night once or twice a week where I'd have four to six.

Those blowout nights are gone. Not because I forced myself. They stopped appealing to me. Now when I go out I have one or two and I'm done, and I genuinely don't feel like I'm missing anything.

Taking Zepbound massively reduced my desire to drink alcohol. Realistically, I probably would not have had the willpower to cut down if I hadn't gone on it. If you're struggling to get this habit under control, it can probably help you too.

s3.title: Stop Drinking 3 Hours Before Bed
s3.hook: Your last drink should be at least three hours before you go to bed.
s3.body:
I know a lot of you are about to argue with me because alcohol knocks you out faster. But falling asleep quickly is not high quality sleep. Alcohol wrecks your sleep quality, and I can see it on my Oura Ring every single time I drink. Deep sleep collapses. Heart rate stays elevated all night.

Bad sleep means worse recovery, more hunger the next day and less willpower to say no to anything.

This is a sleep protection rule. The further the alcohol is from your bedtime, the more of it your body has already cleared and the less of your deep sleep it takes from you. Same number of drinks, same night out. You just front-load it and stop early.
